    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'species_richness']).copy()

    dd = pd.concat([d.reset_index(drop=True), B.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)

    m = smf.ols('species_richness ~ ' + ' + '.join(cols) + ' + C(region)', data=dd).fit()
